# RunningEventsNearMe

> The UK's running event directory. Find road races, trail runs, 5Ks, 10Ks, half marathons, marathons, and ultra events near you — searchable by location, distance type, and date.

## What this site does

- Lets runners search for events by postcode or "near me" (geolocation), returning results sorted by proximity in miles

- Lists running events across all UK regions: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland

- Provides dedicated pages for each UK region (e.g. /running-events/south-east, /running-events/scotland)

- Allows race organisers to submit their events via /list-your-event

## Who it is for

- Recreational and competitive runners looking for their next event in the UK

- Race organisers wanting free directory listings

- Running clubs and coaches sourcing events for members and looking for promotion and traffic for their own events

## Key pages

- / — Homepage with location-based search

- /running-events/[region] — Regional event listings (e.g. /running-events/london, /running-events/yorkshire-humber)

- /list-your-event — Free submission form for race organisers

## Data

Events sourced from England Athletics RunEvents, Welsh Athletics, Athletics NI, and parkrun. Coverage: May–December 2026, expanding continuously. Each event record includes name, date, town, county, distance type, entry fee (where known), and a link to the official event page.

## Contact

For event submissions or corrections: via the /list-your-event page.
